From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Dana Li <dana.li@procureops.com>, Mike Chen <mike.chen@nimble-retail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement decision mapping — vendor packet & next steps

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and clear asks so we can keep procurement moving: 

1) Preferred procurement path: you mentioned Finance prefers PO routing for enterprise contracts (confirmed by Mike) — please mark if that changes.
2) Vendor setup: we need the standard vendor packet (W-9 for US entities or W-8 for foreign) + banking details.
3) Marketplace option: you said marketplace is "possible later" but not preferred for initial purchase.

Action items I can take immediately:
- I will send our vendor_setup_packet + Redwood W-9 template for your vendor team to review (attached).
- Rishi (cc) will map contract terms and send a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) showing milestones for procurement and deployment.

Questions for you: 
- Confirm PO workflow (purchase order number cadence, approximate lead time to issue PO).
- Do you require a vendor portal invite or do you prefer email-based setup?

Attachments: vendor_setup_packet.pdf (vendor forms), W9_Redwood.pdf (company W-9 stub), banking_instructions.xlsx (banking form).

Suggested next step: 30-minute touchpoint late this week to confirm the MAP and slot for procurement intake. I can do Thu 7/15 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 7/16 9:00–10:00 PT.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

—
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Thanks Lauren — clear summary. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- Procurement path: PO is our default for new vendors. Expecting a 7–10 business day turnaround once the vendor packet and W-9 are validated.
- Vendor portal: we do have a portal (ProcureOps) but can accept emailed vendor packets for initial setup — portal invite is preferred for recurring vendors.

Can you please: 
1) Share vendor_setup_packet.pdf and W-9 (we didn't receive the W-9 in the doc package you mentioned).
2) Include instructions for the banking sheet — our finance team requires a completed banking_instructions.xlsx with an ACH example.

Also looping in our procurement lead, Mike (cc), to keep timelines aligned.

Thanks,
Dana Li
Head of Procurement Operations
ProcureOps

Appreciate the fast reply, Dana. A couple operational notes from our side: 

- Timeline: Once we receive the completed vendor packet + W-9 and banking sheet, our ops team will validate within 2 business days and issue any follow-ups. Expect that validation to be the gating item before you can raise a PO.
- Contracting: I'll draft a 1-page Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that calls out procurement milestones, expected delivery dates for paperwork, and an internal sign-off path for both sides. Will share by EOD today.
- Marketplace: if you prefer the ProcureOps portal long-term, we can register Redwood as a supplier there; that process typically adds 5–7 business days.

Doc actions: I will attach a short MAP and a DocuSign link to the vendor packet to make completion easier. Let me know if your finance team prefers manual upload or DocuSign.

-Rishi
